<!-- Thank you for your contribution! Please follow these guidelines to enhance your pull request. If anything is unclear, submit your PR and reach out to maintainers for assistance. Join our Slack community at https://slack.sglang.io to discuss further. -->

## Motivation

Fix 5 failures in NPU diffusion CI:

- **D001 — MiniMax-H3 slowdown after #42370.** That PR made consistency tests request `quality="exact"`. For MiniMax-H3, this turns off the Cache-DiT mode enabled by the CI configuration, so the 2-NPU test no longer uses its intended acceleration.
- **D002 — GLM-Image requests rejected after #41585.** That PR added strict validation to `/generate`, but the schema omitted `image_grid_thw`, which GLM-Image sends to its autoregressive encoder. Valid GLM-Image requests therefore fail with HTTP 400 before generation.
- **D003 — JoyAI times out downloading its input image.** The test fetches an image from GitHub Releases while running. A network timeout stops the test before generation. 
- **D004 — failure analyzer blind to diffusion failures.** `Analyze failure report` only downloads `selected-test-logs-*`, so diffusion consistency failures (published as `diffusion-failures-*` artifacts) never appear in the report, and empty input is reported as `Failed: 0`.
- **D005 — MiniMax-H3 consistency regression after #38671.** That merged PR makes `num_inference_steps=50` run 50 denoising updates instead of 49, shifting the sampled trajectory. The Ascend golden pinned at `609c4cef` was generated on the old 49-update trajectory and no longer matches (min SSIM 0.74 vs threshold 0.92) while the performance check stays green.

## Modifications

- Let the MiniMax-H3 2-NPU test keep its configured Cache-DiT mode. Other tests keep their existing quality settings.
- Add `image_grid_thw` to the API schema and update the generated Python/Rust types. Include the encoder's response body in error logs so future validation failures are easier to diagnose.
- Download and cache JoyAI's input image during CI setup, through the CI proxy. Verify its checksum and install it atomically so parallel jobs can safely share the cache. The test then reads the local file; standalone runs can still use the original URL.
- Teach `Analyze failure report` to also download `diffusion-failures-*` artifacts, parse each partition's `consistency_failures/summary.json` into the failed list plus a dedicated metrics section, and state explicitly when no input artifacts were found instead of a misleading `Failed: 0`. Also move `continue-on-error` to step level — it is not a `download-artifact` input and logged a warning on every run.
- Bump the Ascend consistency GT pin to `2173af2f` (sgl-project/ci-data-diffusion). The MiniMax-H3 frames were regenerated by the NPU GT generation workflow on this branch (run 38069422051) with Cache-DiT enabled (steps=50, Fn=2, Bn=1, rdt=0.4) — the exact code path the test runs. CLIP/SSIM/PSNR thresholds are unchanged.

The input-image cache is inspired by #37426, which caches reference outputs for consistency checks. This PR uses the same prefetch approach for an input image and can merge independently.

## Follow-up: Ascend NPU quality choices

Tracked in #43351. Start with MiniMax-H3: define explicit quality choices for Ascend and how each choice controls Cache-DiT, then validate output consistency and latency on A3. Once that support is validated, the NPU test can select a quality tier directly and remove the test-side quality-pinning exception introduced here. Extend support to other Ascend diffusion models as their configurations are validated.

This is follow-up work; this PR preserves the existing MiniMax-H3 cache configuration.

## Accuracy Tests

Covered by CI

## Speed Tests and Profiling

Covered by CI

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [ ] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [ ] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [ ] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

## Review and Merge Process

1. Ping Merge Oncalls to start the process. See the [PR Merge Process](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/MAINTAINER.md#pull-request-merge-process).
2. Get approvals from [CODEOWNERS](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/CODEOWNERS) and other reviewers.
3. Trigger CI tests with [comments](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#how-to-trigger-ci-tests) or contact authorized users to do so.
   - Common commands include `/tag-and-rerun-ci`, `/tag-run-ci-label`, `/rerun-failed-ci`
4. After green CI and required approvals, ask Merge Oncalls or people with Write permission to merge the PR.

# PR #43210 — CI Failures Analysis (2026-10-11)

**PR:** [sgl-project/sglang#43210](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/43210) — `[NPU] Diffusion CI fixes`
**Head analyzed:** `31ad127b` (runs created 2026-10-10 17:29 UTC; NPU run finished 2026-10-11 ~09:00 UTC)

## General conclusion

**Every failure scope this PR targets is now green — all remaining reds are external to the PR.**

- All **4/4 NPU diffusion jobs passed** (`multimodal-gen-test-{1,4}-npu-a3` parts 0/1), including `minimax_h3_t2va_2npu` consistency (D005, fixed by the branch-generated GT `2173af2f`), MiniMax perf (D001), GLM-Image external AR (D002), and JoyAI (D003).
- The remaining failures are: two **chronic NPU LLM failures** also present before this PR's changes (one introduced by a `main` commit), the **chronic rocm10 AMD suite breakage** (fails identically on `main`), **label gating** (`run-ci-extra` not set — by design), and one **Xeon job with infra noise** (missing docker container; `main` passed the same workflow later the same day).
- Nothing in the PR diff (multimodal_gen test config, GT pin, analyzer, `image_grid_thw` schema, prefetch script) touches any failing code path.

## Failures

| Job | Error | PR-related? |
|---|---|---|
| PR Test (NPU) → `base-b-test-1-npu-a3 / run (0)` | `test_npu_hicache_mha.py` 0/10 passed: `RuntimeError: Boolean value of Tensor with more than one value is ambiguous` at `kv_cache_builder.py:381` (`getattr(pool, side, None) or ()`) | **No** — line introduced by `main` #40135 "[HiCache] Auto-size the host pool"; same failure documented on run 38035649415 (Oct 10, daily report #003) before the branch's latest merges. PR doesn't touch `srt/mem_cache`. |
| PR Test (NPU) → `base-b-test-16-npu-a3 / run (0)` | `test_npu_pd_disaggregation.py` exit code 5 after 626 s | **No** — chronic NPU CI failure (same test in daily report #003's analyzer output); PR doesn't touch PD disaggregation. |
| PR Test (NPU) → `pr-test-npu-finish` | Aggregator: fails because of the two jobs above | No — not a real failure. |
| PR Test Extra → `call-gate / pr-gate` (and `pr-test-extra-finish`) | Step "Require run-ci-extra label (optional)": PR labels are `[npu, run-ci, diffusion]`, no `run-ci-extra` → workflow gated | **No** — by-design label gating, not a test failure. Same for PR Test Extra (AMD). |
| PR Test (AMD) → `stage-b-*-mi35x (0/1)`, `stage-b-test-1-gpu-large-amd (12)`, `multimodal-gen-test-{1,2}-gpu-amd (rocm10, parts …)`, `wait-for-stage-b-amd`, `pr-test-amd-finish` | rocm10 suite: Triton compile `FAILED: [code=1] cuda_0.o`, `test_ipc_a2a_lifecycle` (NVLink IPC on AMD), LoRA relaxed-check failures | **No** — chronic repo-wide rocm10 breakage: `main`'s own run 38099805135 (Oct 11 00:50 UTC) fails the **identical job set**; every recent AMD run on other PR branches is red too. |
| PR Test (Xeon) → `build-test (xeon-spr, …, spr2, 1, 3)` | Step "Run unit tests (SPR)": `test/registered/cpu/test_subblock_sparse_attention.py` → `AssertionError: Torch not compiled with CUDA enabled`. Same job log also shows infra noise: `Error response from daemon: No such container: ci_sglang_spr2`, http_server `Test crash after stream_output called 30 times` (conn refused `:21000/freeze_gc`) | **No** — PR doesn't touch srt/CPU code; docker-container-missing + CUDA-on-CPU mismatch point to runner/env trouble; `main` passed PR Test (Xeon) later the same day (38142481801); this test had a prior Xeon-specific CI fix (#41002). |

## Green (for reference)

Lint, PR Test (Arm64/MLX/PPU/sgl-router/sglang-processor), Auto Label, PR States — all success on `31ad127b`; all 4 NPU diffusion jobs success; PR Test (main) success.

+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""Cache the image-edit input before NPU CI starts loading models."""
+
+import argparse
+import hashlib
+import os
+import subprocess
+import tempfile
+from pathlib import Path
+
+IMAGE_URL = "https://github.com/lm-sys/lm-sys.github.io/releases/download/test/TI2I_Qwen_Image_Edit_Input.jpg"
+IMAGE_SHA256 = "0d56a63fca6ef8fe2a0ca27a0774c2bada9b2a198aeedbfdfb23bec09d0d3901"
+
+
+def prefetch(cache_root: Path) -> Path:
+    cache_dir = cache_root.expanduser().resolve() / IMAGE_SHA256
+    cache_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    image = cache_dir / "TI2I_Qwen_Image_Edit_Input.jpg"
+    if (
+        image.is_file()
+        and hashlib.sha256(image.read_bytes()).hexdigest() == IMAGE_SHA256
+    ):
+        return image
+
+    # Unique staging files and atomic replacement allow concurrent partitions.
+    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="download-", dir=cache_dir) as staging:
+        downloaded = Path(staging) / image.name
+        subprocess.run(
+            [
+                "curl",
+                "--fail",
+                "--location",
+                "--retry",
+                "2",
+                "--connect-timeout",
+                "30",
+                "--max-time",
+                "120",
+                "--output",
+                str(downloaded),
+                os.environ.get("GITHUB_PROXY_URL", "") + IMAGE_URL,
+            ],
+            check=True,
+            timeout=400,
+        )
+        if hashlib.sha256(downloaded.read_bytes()).hexdigest() != IMAGE_SHA256:
+            raise ValueError("Image-edit input SHA-256 mismatch")
+        downloaded.replace(image)
+    return image
+
+
+def main() -> None:
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
+    parser.add_argument(
+        "--cache-root", type=Path, default=Path("~/.cache/sglang/inputs")
+    )
+    args = parser.parse_args()
+    image = prefetch(args.cache_root)
+    line = f"SGLANG_TEST_TI2I_INPUT_IMAGE={image}"
+    if github_env := os.environ.get("GITHUB_ENV"):
+        with open(github_env, "a", encoding="utf-8") as output:
+            output.write(line + "\n")
+    print(line)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()

# PR #43210 — CI Failures Analysis (2026-10-11)

**PR:** [sgl-project/sglang#43210](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/43210) — `[NPU] Diffusion CI fixes`
**Head analyzed:** `31ad127b` (runs created 2026-10-10 17:29 UTC; NPU run finished 2026-10-11 ~09:00 UTC)

## General conclusion

**Every failure scope this PR targets is now green — all remaining reds are external to the PR.**

- All **4/4 NPU diffusion jobs passed** (`multimodal-gen-test-{1,4}-npu-a3` parts 0/1), including `minimax_h3_t2va_2npu` consistency (D005, fixed by the branch-generated GT `2173af2f`), MiniMax perf (D001), GLM-Image external AR (D002), and JoyAI (D003).
- The remaining failures are: two **chronic NPU LLM failures** also present before this PR's changes (one introduced by a `main` commit), the **chronic rocm10 AMD suite breakage** (fails identically on `main`), **label gating** (`run-ci-extra` not set — by design), and one **Xeon job with infra noise** (missing docker container; `main` passed the same workflow later the same day).
- Nothing in the PR diff (multimodal_gen test config, GT pin, analyzer, `image_grid_thw` schema, prefetch script) touches any failing code path.

## Failures

| Job | Error | PR-related? |
|---|---|---|
| PR Test (NPU) → `base-b-test-1-npu-a3 / run (0)` | `test_npu_hicache_mha.py` 0/10 passed: `RuntimeError: Boolean value of Tensor with more than one value is ambiguous` at `kv_cache_builder.py:381` (`getattr(pool, side, None) or ()`) | **No** — line introduced by `main` #40135 "[HiCache] Auto-size the host pool"; same failure documented on run 38035649415 (Oct 10, daily report #003) before the branch's latest merges. PR doesn't touch `srt/mem_cache`. |
| PR Test (NPU) → `base-b-test-16-npu-a3 / run (0)` | `test_npu_pd_disaggregation.py` exit code 5 after 626 s | **No** — chronic NPU CI failure (same test in daily report #003's analyzer output); PR doesn't touch PD disaggregation. |
| PR Test (NPU) → `pr-test-npu-finish` | Aggregator: fails because of the two jobs above | No — not a real failure. |
| PR Test Extra → `call-gate / pr-gate` (and `pr-test-extra-finish`) | Step "Require run-ci-extra label (optional)": PR labels are `[npu, run-ci, diffusion]`, no `run-ci-extra` → workflow gated | **No** — by-design label gating, not a test failure. Same for PR Test Extra (AMD). |
| PR Test (AMD) → `stage-b-*-mi35x (0/1)`, `stage-b-test-1-gpu-large-amd (12)`, `multimodal-gen-test-{1,2}-gpu-amd (rocm10, parts …)`, `wait-for-stage-b-amd`, `pr-test-amd-finish` | rocm10 suite: Triton compile `FAILED: [code=1] cuda_0.o`, `test_ipc_a2a_lifecycle` (NVLink IPC on AMD), LoRA relaxed-check failures | **No** — chronic repo-wide rocm10 breakage: `main`'s own run 38099805135 (Oct 11 00:50 UTC) fails the **identical job set**; every recent AMD run on other PR branches is red too. |

Same job log also shows infra noise: `Error response from daemon: No such container: ci_sglang_spr2`, http_server `Test crash after stream_output called 30 times` (conn refused `:21000/freeze_gc`) | **No** — PR doesn't touch srt/CPU code; docker-container-missing + CUDA-on-CPU mismatch point to runner/env trouble; `main` passed PR Test (Xeon) later the same day (38142481801); this test had a prior Xeon-specific CI fix (#41002). |
